# How exceptions accumulate — M06

Six-quarter accounting game. Move requests between new, tailored, standard and retired lanes using pointer/touch or each card’s select. Plans settle on advance; Undo includes settlement. Values and costs are explicit. Standards lower maintenance and pair friction, and reduce new related tailored setup. Expired benefit does not remove upkeep automatically. Costs can be challenged before the first quarter; completed policy comparisons use the same settings and progressively revealed request sequence.

Local persistence, replay, Markdown/JSON export. Fictional value points; no capacity, stochastic failure or discounting model. Run `node --test dist/exceptions/engine.test.js`: recurring versus one-off accounting, retirement, pair/reuse mechanisms, deterministic comparison and policy-ranking reversal.
